title: AR22001: Advanced Building Materials And Composites
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Metal and metal components – Basic Metallurgy of Iron & Steel, composite &
grades of steel, heat treatment of steel, corrosion of metals and protection,
non-ferrous metals-aluminium and aluminium alloys, copper, brass, bronze, lead,
zinc, tin .Precast concrete blocks- their methods of preparation and uses.
Paints and varnishes- different types, uses, methods of application on
different surfaces. Glass and glazing. Heat insulating and acoustic materials
and components. Organic binders and bitumen-&-tar-based materials – Bitumen,
tars, emulsions, mastics, waterproofing items, steam-proofing and sealing
materials. Polymers and polymer-based materials and components- polymers and
plastics, polymer based building materials for walls, pipes, sanitary-ware,
glues, mastics.
commercial names of common products of respective companies.
